# Story 08 — Customer Notes (Story: CRM-35)

---

## Prerequisites

- Story CRM-30 completed: base Customer Management module (Customer entity, `CustomerDbContext`, `CustomerEndpoints`, EF Core PostgreSQL persistence).
- Story CRM-31/32/33 completed: Customer CRUD + Customer Profile view (`CustomerProfileView.vue`).
- Story CRM-34 completed: Customer Interactions (mirrors the pattern this story will follow: sub-resource on customer, timeline component, dedicated store, dedicated endpoints file, dedicated EF migration). Reuse this pattern end-to-end.
- Authentication (CRM-27/28/29) completed: JWT bearer auth, `Roles` (`Admin`, `Manager`, `Agent`), authorization policies wired in `Program.cs`.
- Coordinate with the owner of `CustomerDbContext` before adding a new entity + migration.

---

## Story Goal

Deliver an internal **Customer Notes** capability so authorized CRM users (Admin, Manager, Agent) can create, view, edit and delete short internal notes on a customer profile. Notes:

1. Are **internal**: never returned by any customer-facing endpoint.
2. Are scoped to a single customer and authored by the authenticated user.
3. Support the CRUD lifecycle with `CreatedAt` / `UpdatedAt` timestamps.
4. Enforce a simple permission model — the note author (or Admin/Manager) may edit or delete.
5. Appear as a new **Notes** section on the customer profile view (newest first) with loading / empty / error states.

Explicitly out of scope: customer attachments, notes visibility to end customers, note tagging/categorization, rich text/markdown rendering, per-note permissions beyond author + role.

## Backend Tasks

### 1 — Entity: `CustomerNote`

**Create file: `backend/CRM.Api/Customers/CustomerNote.cs`**

```csharp
namespace CRM.Api.Customers;

public class CustomerNote
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public Guid CustomerId { get; set; }
    public Customer? Customer { get; set; }

    // FK to the authoring user (matches Auth/User.cs identifier type).
    public Guid AuthorId { get; set; }

    public string Content { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }
}
```

Constraints:
- **Content max length: 4000** characters (enforce in DB config + DTO validation).
- **AuthorId** is stored but the entity does **not** hold a navigation property to `User` (Auth DB context is separate — see `backend/CRM.Api/Auth/AuthDbContext.cs`). Resolve author display info at read time via the Auth context or by joining in a query if both contexts share the same PostgreSQL database; otherwise expose `AuthorId` and let the response include `AuthorDisplayName` populated from `AuthDbContext.Users` in the endpoint handler.

### 5 — Endpoints

**Create file: `backend/CRM.Api/Customers/CustomerNoteEndpoints.cs`**

Register via a new `MapCustomerNoteEndpoints(this IEndpointRouteBuilder app)` extension. Wire from `Program.cs` next to the existing `MapCustomerEndpoints()` call.

Routes (all require authentication, roles `Admin, Manager, Agent`):

| Method | Route | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/customers/{customerId:guid}/notes` | Returns list ordered by `CreatedAt DESC`. 404 if customer missing. |
| POST | `/api/customers/{customerId:guid}/notes` | Creates a note. Sets `AuthorId` from `ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier`, `CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow`. Returns 201 + `CustomerNoteResponse`. |
| PUT | `/api/customers/{customerId:guid}/notes/{noteId:guid}` | Updates content. Sets `UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow`. Authorization: author OR `Admin` OR `Manager`. 403 otherwise. |
| DELETE | `/api/customers/{customerId:guid}/notes/{noteId:guid}` | Deletes. Same authorization as PUT. Returns 204. |

Validation (in each write handler, before persistence):
- `content` must not be null.
- `content.Trim()` length ≥ 1 (reject whitespace-only).
- `content.Length` ≤ 4000.
- Return `Results.ValidationProblem(...)` with a `content` field error otherwise.

Authorization helper (private static function in the endpoints file):

```csharp
static bool CanModify(CustomerNote note, ClaimsPrincipal user)
    => user.IsInRole(Roles.Admin)
       || user.IsInRole(Roles.Manager)
       || (Guid.TryParse(user.FindFirstValue(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier), out var uid) && uid == note.AuthorId);
```

Guard every route with `.RequireAuthorization(policy => policy.RequireRole(Roles.Admin, Roles.Manager, Roles.Agent))`. This satisfies "Customer role cannot access internal notes" because Customer is not in the allowed set.

Error handling:
- Customer not found → `Results.NotFound(new { error = "customer_not_found" })`.
- Note not found → `Results.NotFound(new { error = "note_not_found" })`.
- Not permitted → `Results.Forbid()`.
- Database exception → let the global handler produce 500 with a generic message (do not leak stack traces).

## Frontend Tasks

### 8 — API client

**Create file: `frontend/CRM.Web/src/api/customerNotes.ts`**

```ts
import { http } from './http'
import type { CustomerNote, CreateCustomerNotePayload, UpdateCustomerNotePayload } from '@/types/customerNotes'

export const listNotes = (customerId: string) =>
  http.get<CustomerNote[]>(`/customers/${customerId}/notes`).then(r => r.data)

export const createNote = (customerId: string, payload: CreateCustomerNotePayload) =>
  http.post<CustomerNote>(`/customers/${customerId}/notes`, payload).then(r => r.data)

export const updateNote = (customerId: string, noteId: string, payload: UpdateCustomerNotePayload) =>
  http.put<CustomerNote>(`/customers/${customerId}/notes/${noteId}`, payload).then(r => r.data)

export const deleteNote = (customerId: string, noteId: string) =>
  http.delete<void>(`/customers/${customerId}/notes/${noteId}`).then(r => r.data)
```

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Empty / whitespace-only content** — rejected client-side (button disabled + inline error) and server-side (`Results.ValidationProblem`). Enforced in `CustomerNoteEndpoints.cs` (POST/PUT handlers) and in `CustomerNotesSection.vue` computed `isValid`.
- **Content > 4000 chars** — textarea `maxlength=4000`; backend rejects with 400. If a client bypasses the input, server is authoritative.
- **Customer not found** on any route — 404 `customer_not_found`; store surfaces `errors.customerNotFound`.
- **Note not found** on PUT/DELETE — 404 `note_not_found`; store surfaces `errors.noteNotFound`.
- **User loses authorization mid-session** — API returns 401/403; shared `http.ts` interceptor already redirects to login on 401. On 403, show `errors.forbidden` and keep the current view.
- **Duplicate submissions** — `saving` flag disables Save; the button also becomes non-clickable while the promise is in flight.
- **Concurrent creates** — no uniqueness constraint; ordering by `CreatedAt DESC` handles display. Ties broken by `Id` (secondary sort in the store).
- **Customer-facing exposure** — Notes endpoints require role `Admin | Manager | Agent`; the `Customer` role (if introduced in future) is not in the allowed list. No customer-portal endpoint reads `CustomerNotes`. Add an assertion test proving a `Customer`-role token receives 403.
- **DB failure** — the endpoint returns 500 via the global exception handler; the store maps that to `errors.save`/`errors.load`/`errors.delete` (no stack traces surfaced).
- **Author display name unavailable** — if the auth lookup fails, respond with `AuthorDisplayName = ""` and let the UI fall back to `t('customers.notes.unknownAuthor')`.
- **Cascade delete of customer** — FK cascade removes notes; verify a customer-delete integration test asserts notes disappear.

## Migration / Rollback

- Migration name: `AddCustomerNotes`.
- **Rollback**: `dotnet ef database update <previous_migration> --context CustomerDbContext` then `dotnet ef migrations remove --context CustomerDbContext`.
- **Half-applied state**: if the schema is applied but the code is reverted, the `CustomerNotes` table sits unused — harmless. If code is deployed but the migration isn't applied, GET/POST/PUT/DELETE all throw `PostgresException: relation "CustomerNotes" does not exist` — deploy runbook must apply migrations before rolling out the new API image.
- No data backfill required (new feature, no existing rows).
